title: Rename email review option 'Only untrusted senders' to 'Manage per sender'
summary: The caption of the OnlyIfUntrusted option in the Payables Agent Email Review Policy enum changes from 'Only untrusted senders (recommended)' to 'Manage per sender (recommended)'.
key_points: Caption of enum option OnlyIfUntrusted changed to 'Manage per sender (recommended)'
Affects enum 3305 PA Email Review Policy in the Payables Agent app
Only the caption changes; the enum value name stays OnlyIfUntrusted
